content: AnnotationOverflowResolution (iOS 17+) controls what happens when an annotation would overflow the plot/chart area. .annotation(position: .top, spacing: 0, overflowResolution: .init(x: .fit(to: .chart), y: .fit(to: .chart))) clamps the floating callout at chart edges instead of letting it render outside/get clipped. Community reports (Apple Developer Forums threads 737244, 741642) note overflowResolution can misbehave when combined with certain other chart modifiers (e.g. chartScrollableAxis) — verify visually on device once implemented.
